verdict.rationale: The CLI documents a `--skill` flag that installs only named skills from a collection, repeatable for several (e.g. `--skill frontend-design --skill skill-creator`), with `'*'` for all. It also supports a direct path to a single skill in a repo, and `--list` shows a repo's skills before installing, which a runtime probe confirmed (9 skills listed, nothing installed). Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that a `--skill`-filtered install itself installs only the chosen skills (the probe only exercised `--list`).
